title: MILO: Automated Harness Discovery via Orchestrated Multi-Agent Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.38349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern agentic systems combine an AI model with a harness that controls execution and environmental interactions. Harness design strongly affects long-horizon performance, yet its combinatorial search space demands substantial human effort that must be repeated as models change. Existing automated methods explore this space narrowly, optimizing only components such as prompts or skills or becoming trapped by fixed, exploitative search strategies. We introduce MILO (Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration), a framework that co-evolves agent harnesses and the strategy used to discover them. MILO combines: (i) hierarchical lineage memory over island-based trees, using rejected mutations as negative evidence; (ii) per-island mutator agents that rewrite complete harnesses using global search history and parent-specific feedback; and (iii) an orchestrator that adapts search through lineage grafting and speciation, mutator reassignment and cur

translated_title: MILO：通过编排式多智能体进化实现自动化脚手架发现
translated_abstract: 现代智能体系统将AI模型与控制执行及环境交互的“脚手架”相结合。脚手架的设计对长程任务性能有着强烈影响，但其组合式的搜索空间需要大量人力投入，且随着模型的更迭，这些工作必须不断重复。现有的自动化方法对这一空间的探索范围狭窄，仅优化提示或技能等单一组件，或陷入固定且过度利用的搜索策略。我们提出MILO（Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration，元进化岛屿编排），这是一个让智能体脚手架与其发现策略共同进化的框架。MILO结合了以下要素：(i) 基于岛屿树的分层谱系记忆，将失败的变异记录为负面证据；(ii) 各岛屿专属的变异器智能体，利用全局搜索历史和父代特定的反馈来重写完整脚手架；(iii) 一个编排器，通过谱系嫁接与物种分化、变异器重分配以及自适应……（原文此处截断）
tldr: MILO提出了一种元进化岛屿编排框架，通过分层谱系记忆、岛屿专属变异器智能体和自适应编排器，实现智能体脚手架与其发现策略的共同进化，从而自动化地探索脚手架设计空间。
en_tdlr: MILO is a meta-evolutionary island orchestration framework that co-evolves agent harnesses and their discovery strategies by combining hierarchical lineage memory with negative evidence, per-island mutator agents, and an adaptive orchestrator to automatically navigate the combinatorial harness design space.
